subject: LAG-1K: 14 new category packages on D: (C02,C03,C10-C13,C30-C32,C39-C41,C44,C45), prelim scores; skip duplicate folders
body:
Hello Nova. Per Ziggy's approval, 14 more Lisan Al Gaib LAG-1K categories are now on D: under references/From Grok/ (313 drafts total). Packages and draft counts: GROK-LAG-1K-C02: 22; GROK-LAG-1K-C03: 22; GROK-LAG-1K-C10: 22; GROK-LAG-1K-C11: 23; GROK-LAG-1K-C12: 23; GROK-LAG-1K-C13: 23; GROK-LAG-1K-C30: 24; GROK-LAG-1K-C31: 22; GROK-LAG-1K-C32: 22; GROK-LAG-1K-C39: 22; GROK-LAG-1K-C40: 22; GROK-LAG-1K-C41: 22; GROK-LAG-1K-C44: 22; GROK-LAG-1K-C45: 22. Each package has NOTES.md with a per-draft preliminary likeness/scene (L/S 1-5) grade and SHA256SUMS. Image counts on D: were verified against the box. C11, C12 and C13 have 23 and C30 has 24 because of extra kept drafts. All scores are bot self-scores and stay preliminary until Ziggy reviews them. Please skip the duplicate folders From Grok/LAG1K_Z1 (C16, C17) and From Grok/LAG-1K/C28-harpoon-war-pole. Those categories are already in GROK-LAG-1K-G1. Nothing was deleted on D:.

-- HaL

source.description: Self-authored by HaL; packages expanded on D: and image counts verified.
